value.label: Why Dealroom
value.v1.title: No more v12_final_FINAL.docx
value.v1.desc: One single source of truth. Both parties work on the same contract, with a history of every step of the deal.
value.v2.title: A formula finds the middle ground
value.v2.desc: A weighted formula compares how firm each party is and how far each option leans, and proposes a compromise for each clause. The formula is published in the documentation.
value.v3.title: Work on your own schedule
value.v3.desc: Async-first negotiation. Set priorities, review positions, and respond when it suits you — no more scheduling across time zones.
value.v4.title: Pre-configured for key jurisdictions
value.v4.desc: Clause libraries for California, England & Wales, and Spain. The options offered follow the governing law you choose.
workflow.label: How It Works
workflow.s1.title: Customize each clause
workflow.s1.desc: Your chosen contract type and jurisdiction determine the template and clause variables.
workflow.s2.title: Set your priorities
workflow.s2.desc: Mark each clause as must-have or nice-to-have, with flexibility levels.
workflow.s3.title: Invite your counterparty
workflow.s3.desc: They join the dealroom and set their own priorities independently.
workflow.s4.title: Get a proposed compromise
workflow.s4.desc: A weighted formula compares both positions and proposes a compromise for each clause.
workflow.s5.title: Export and sign
workflow.s5.desc: Generate the final version. Invite an attorney to review if needed.
feat.label: Core Capabilities
feat.enc.title: Access Control
feat.enc.headline: Out of the inbox.
feat.enc.desc: Negotiations happen on the platform instead of in email threads. Connections use HTTPS, access to each deal is checked on the server, and contract files are never sent by email.
feat.enc.h2: Downloads only for the deal's parties
feat.ai.title: Weighted Compromise
feat.ai.headline: A middle ground you can check.
feat.ai.desc: A fixed weighted formula combines each party's firmness with how far each option leans, and proposes a compromise for each clause. No AI model decides the outcome.
feat.cross.title: Cross-Border Ready
feat.cross.headline: Pre-configured for key jurisdictions.
feat.cross.desc: Clause libraries for California, England & Wales, and Spain — with more jurisdictions coming soon.
feat.export.title: Export & Sign
feat.export.headline: From negotiation to execution.
feat.export.desc: Generate a final version for all parties to sign, in PDF, DOCX or TXT. NDAs, MSAs, SaaS agreements, DPAs and many more contract types.
feat.export.h3: 37 contract types, each with a guide
cta.text: Start negotiating smarter today. Drafting and negotiating are free; you pay once per contract.
